meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — statutory corporate law modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law and the Model Business Corporation Act, within a US-style common-law framework that also recognizes customary Marshallese law

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990, Title 31, Chapter 1 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code (31 MIRC Ch. 1); Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2018, as amended (AML/CFT Act); subsidiary Financial Intelligence Unit Regulations; AML/CFT obligations imposed on licensed registered agents (trust and company service providers). Beneficial ownership data is collected and held privately by the licensed registered agent and by the Registrar of Corporations in the Office of the Attorney-General; no public UBO register is maintained.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based due diligence before incorporation: each UBO (natural person owning more than 25% or exercising control), director, officer and account signatory must be screened against the UN Consolidated Security Council Sanctions List, the US OFAC Specially Designated Nationals List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the UK OFSI consolidated list, and RMI Financial Intelligence Unit circulars, including domestic PEP registers and adverse-media checks. The licensed registered agent must apply FATF-aligned customer due diligence (valid government-issued photo ID, proof of address, source of funds and source of wealth) and must file Suspicious Transaction Reports with the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit where required. Payment service providers (Stripe and Paddle) will apply their own merchant KYC and OFAC screening and will typically require the apostilled Certificate of Good Standing, the UBO attestation and evidence of operational substance before account activation for the SEO/SaaS analytics business.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Attorney-General's Office); name clearance and reservation are processed through a licensed RMI Registered Agent and confirmed by written Registrar letter. No public online registry portal exists.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in English (Latin script) using letters A-Z, numerals 0-9 and permitted punctuation, and must include a corporate designator such as 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited' or an approved abbreviation. Marshallese-language names are accepted only in Latin transliteration; names in non-Latin scripts require a certified English transliteration. The name must be distinguishable from existing register entries and must not falsely imply a governmental, banking, trust, insurance or regulated purpose.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: United Nations / Red Cross / Red Crescent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A reservation may be renewed for one additional 30-day period by refiling through the Registered Agent before expiry. If the Registrar rejects a name, the applicant may (i) accept the rejection and file a revised name reservation with distinguishing elements; (ii) file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 days, attaching evidence of prior ministerial consent or clearance for any sensitive token; or (iii) after final administrative refusal, petition the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands for judicial review within 30 days of the refusal, while maintaining a protective alternative name reservation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this industry. The Business Corporations Act requires a registered office and a licensed registered agent physically located in the Marshall Islands; the registered office may be the registered agent's office address. A non-resident SEO analytics SaaS corporation (ISIC 6201; no statutory license required) may operate fully remotely with no RMI premises, employees or assets. Merchant acquirers (Stripe/Paddle) may, however, require evidence of an operational address, domain ownership and commercial substance outside RMI.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — quantified risk estimated at below 5% per annum for a non-resident, non-regulated, low-risk MarTech SaaS entity with no physical RMI presence. The principal inspection channel is AML/CFT supervision of the licensed registered agent by the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit rather than direct unannounced on-site inspection of the client corporation.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (BCA), Title 32 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code; Sections 16 (Articles of Incorporation), 26 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), 49 (Board of Directors), and 50 (Officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance and Banking, Majuro, Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1) filed with the Registrar of Corporations
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital or escrow account requirement. Authorized capital may be set at USD 100.00 divided into no-par or par-value shares; actual paid-in capital is at the incorporator's discretion.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Incorporator subscribes for 100 shares of common stock at par value USD 1.00 per share and that all subscription payments be remitted to the corporate bank account in accordance with the Bylaws. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation be located at the office of the Resident Agent in Majuro, Marshall Islands, and that the Resident Agent be appointed as agent for service of process. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the individuals named in the Organization Meeting Minutes be and hereby are appointed as officers: President, Secretary, and Treasurer, with authority to execute banking and payment processor (Stripe/Paddle) agreements. FURTHER RESOLVED, that corporate books and records be maintained at the registered office and that the Treasurer authenticate all equity records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Search and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct an availability search through the Registrar's online portal or by written request; verify that the proposed corporate name is distinctive and not misleading. Engage a licensed resident agent to serve as registered agent with a physical office in Majuro; obtain the agent's signed consent and reserve the corporate name for up to 30 days.
required_dossiers: Signed resident agent consent and acknowledgement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused because of similarity, submit a written explanation or choose a secondary name; alternatively, file a statutory declaration and obtain a waiver or consent from the conflicting entity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft Articles of Incorporation in English containing the corporate name, the general business purpose, registered office address in Majuro, name and address of the resident agent, authorized share structure, and any lawful limitations on business powers. Execute the document by the incorporator and have each signature notarized.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a technical deficiency notice, file an amended Articles page or clarified cross-reference within the stated response deadline; request expedited re-review upon cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission, Fee Payment, and Statutory Examination
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Articles of Incorporation together with the statutory filing fee and any supporting consents either online through the Registrar's portal or physically at the Companies Registry counter in Majuro. The Registrar examines the documents for compliance with Section 16 of the Business Corporations Act and processes the application in the order of receipt.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or rejected, the incorporator or resident agent may file a written response with corrected documents and pay any corrected fee; after two failed attempts, the applicant may administratively appeal to the Registrar or seek judicial review in the RMI High Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Seal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon favorable examination, the Registrar endorses the Articles and issues a Certificate of Incorporation containing the official date of incorporation and file number. The Corporation adopts a corporate seal, opens a minute book, and records the text of the Bylaws adopted by the incorporator.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the filing receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains typographical or identity errors, file a Certificate of Correction under Section 16(7) of the BCA with the Registrar to issue a corrected certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, First Board Resolution, and Fiscal Agent Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Directors and Registered Office, Majuro, Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the initial organizational meeting or execute unanimous written consents in lieu of a meeting. Adopt the Bylaws, appoint the officers, approve the share subscriptions, designate the bank account and Stripe/Paddle payment processor as fiscal agents, and confirm the registered office address as the seat of the Corporation. Record all actions in the corporate records and file the annual franchise tax return with the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the Organizational Meeting or unanimous written consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any officer refuses appointment, the Board may pass a replacement resolution; if the registered agent terminates, the Corporation must within 30 days appoint a replacement agent and file Notice of Change of Registered Agent to avoid administrative dissolution.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Marshall Islands Business Development Board and Office of the Registrar of Corporations; not applicable to ISIC 6201 purely digital MarTech analytics services
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating license or manufacturing permit required for a non-resident Marshall Islands Business Corporation providing search engine optimization data crawling and keyword analytics as a Software-as-a-Service tool without any physical industrial plant in the Republic

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category 3 (Non-Physical Digital Service). No Environmental Impact Assessment required where the activity is exclusively cloud-hosted data processing with no construction, land disturbance, or point-source discharge.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to virtual operations. If redundant servers are co-located in the Republic, the operator must maintain zero process wastewater discharge, observe RMIEPA ambient air quality limits for diesel standby generators, and ensure electronic waste is handled by a certified recycler under EPA Waste Management Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and structural load inspections are not applicable for a registered agent-only presence. If a physical office is leased in Majuro, obtain RMI Fire and Rescue clearance, a building occupancy inspection for the intended office use, and an occupational health clearance for computer workstation operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) Ministry of Finance — Revenue and Taxation Division, Majuro Atoll, in conjunction with the RMI Office of the Registrar of Corporations (Business Corporations Act registry) administered through licensed registered agents. There is no national online tax filing portal; filings are paper-based or agent-mediated.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate a Business Corporation as a non-resident domestic corporation under the Business Corporations Act (BCCA) through a licensed Registered Agent; the Certificate of Incorporation carries the RMI corporate registration number. Step 2: File the annual corporate renewal and pay the fixed annual government fee to the Registrar of Corporations; this renewal is the operative ongoing compliance identifier. Step 3: No income-tax TIN is statutorily required for a non-resident BC engaged in offshore activity, and no VAT identification number exists because the RMI imposes no VAT or GST. Step 4: Only if an RMI nexus later materializes (RMI-source income, local payroll, or physical importation of goods) must the BC apply to the Revenue and Taxation Division for a TIN and file the corresponding returns, withholding, or customs declarations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The RMI does not provide a US-style check-the-box election, transparent-entity election, or hybrid-mismatch election. Exemption is automatic and statutory at incorporation provided the corporation is non-resident-owned, has no RMI-source gross income, and conducts no business within the RMI. A prospective re-designation as a Resident Domestic Corporation is available but would trigger RMI domestic tax exposure to the extent of RMI-source activities. There are no hybrid entity classification regimes under the BCCA.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None — the RMI levies no VAT, GST, or general sales-and-use tax. The only indirect fiscal levy is the Customs Import Duty on physical goods entering the RMI, which does not apply to exported SaaS or digitally delivered SEO analytics services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: N/A — no VAT or GST statute exists, so no registration threshold applies; customs import duty obligations arise only upon actual physical importation of goods into the RMI and have no application to offshore digital service revenue.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None — there is no national electronic invoicing mandate, real-time fiscal clearance requirement, tax-authority API integration, or digital stamping regime. Invoices may be issued in any commercially acceptable format. Records must be retained with sufficient detail to substantiate non-resident status and the offshore source of service revenue under BCCA books-and-records requirements; seven-year retention is the prudent market practice for the SaaS export model.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable as a VAT zero-rating mechanism because the RMI has no VAT or GST. The BC's cross-border supply of the SEO Content Analytics Tool (ISIC 6201 / NAICS 541511) is entirely outside the RMI taxing jurisdiction while the corporation remains non-resident, maintains no RMI office, staff, or assets, generates no RMI-source income, and delivers services through foreign cloud infrastructure. There is no export VAT charge that could be zero-rated and consequently no refund claim to file.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration — required only for physical goods departing an RMI port; not applicable to cloud-delivered software subscriptions but retained where data-collection hardware or proxy servers transit the RMI.

Bill of Lading / Airway Bill — applicable only where physical analytics infrastructure moves through an RMI port; otherwise the commercial SaaS subscription agreement and delivery records evidence cross-border service supply.

Inward Remittance Certificate / bank FX settlement records — evidencing receipt of subscription fees from non-resident customers through payment rails such as Stripe or Paddle within 180 days of invoice issuance.

Non-Resident Status Evidence Bundle — Certificate of Incorporation, annual corporate renewal receipt from the Registrar of Corporations, Registered Agent confirmation, and a board resolution confirming the absence of RMI business activity and RMI-source income.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No RMI VAT clawback exists because no export-VAT refund mechanism applies to this structure. Material compliance risks: (i) if the Registrar of Corporations or the Revenue and Taxation Division determines that the BC conducted actual business in the RMI, derived RMI-source income, or used property located in the RMI, the non-resident exemption is lost retrospectively, exposing the entity to RMI tax assessments, statutory non-resident withholding obligations, municipal business license fees, customs import duties, and social-security contributions on any RMI-based personnel; (ii) false certificates, inaccurate annual filings, or failure to maintain records attract administrative fines, deregistration, and reinstatement penalties under the BCCA; (iii) directors and registered agents making fraudulent declarations may face criminal liability; (iv) under RMI tax information exchange agreements, beneficial ownership and revenue data may be exchanged with a foreign tax authority, enabling retrospective foreign tax clawback with interest and penalties where the RMI structure lacks economic substance. No RMI refund remedy exists for taxes never imposed.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No central bank exists in the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI). The RMI uses the U.S. Dollar (USD) as legal tender; banking supervision is vested in the RMI Banking Commissioner under the Banking Act 1991.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility - the RMI does not operate any foreign exchange control. Both current account and capital account transactions are unrestricted, and there are no profit remittance hurdles, registration requirements, or official FX approval procedures. Dividends and capital distributions to non-resident shareholders can be paid without local permission; only standard commercial bank AML/CFT and beneficial-ownership verification apply.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable - RMI imposes no statutory surrender, conversion, or repatriation timeline on export proceeds. Export receipts may be retained in USD or any other freely convertible currency; banks must retain transaction records for anti-money-laundering/CTF purposes under RMI AML obligations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Current Account (also escrow-capable for capital commitments)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam - Marshall Islands Branch

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium - Cross-border fintech EMI providers (e.g., Wise Business, Revolut Business, Mercury, Payoneer) are not locally licensed in RMI and do not offer native RMI accounts. An RMI Business Corporation may be eligible to open an account with a non-U.S. EMI under the EMI's own foreign-company KYC policy, but mainstream EMIs commonly decline RMI offshore-registered entities because of perceived offshore-banking risk, substance expectations, and tax-facilitation concerns. For a core treasury, a Marshall Islands domestic bank account or a U.S. correspondent account obtained through an introducer is more reliable.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory requirement exists for directors to appear physically before an RMI bank. In practice, RMI commercial banks will accept a certified copy of a passport, apostilled corporate documents, and a live video interview with a director or authorized signatory. The bank must obtain positive file verification of beneficial owners and may require a notarized board resolution. Remote onboarding is feasible but subject to enhanced due diligence when the BC is non-resident with no physical substance in Majuro.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Onboarding a non-resident legal person incorporated in an offshore jurisdiction with no physical office in-country
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, current Registered Agent certificate, full beneficial-ownership chart, board resolution for account opening, and a substance summary describing the SaaS/SEO analytics business model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Intangible revenue stream with low corporate substance and high cross-border exposure (SaaS subscriptions)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: License agreement or product terms of service, live platform demo or product URL, merchant processing agreements (Stripe/Paddle), sample invoice and contractual client list, and 6-month management accounts or audited financials if available.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds for initial share capital originates from a non-treaty personal jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-wealth statement, three months' source-of-funds bank statements, personal tax or statutory declaration of lawful income, and a notarized declaration of beneficial ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Individual directors/beneficial owners located outside the banking jurisdiction with no historical footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized or apostilled passport copies, proof of residential address (utility bill, bank statement), director profile/CV, and a video interview transcript; for certain high-risk jurisdictions, add an independent background-search report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected transaction pattern shows immediate outbound disbursement of ticket size that diverges from stated trade purpose
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved treasury plan, cash-flow budget, executed client agreements, pro-forma vendor invoices for SaaS infrastructure or contractor payments, and a reconciliation line between the wire purpose code and disbursement schedule.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions from shareholder accounts should be wired to the RMI BC's USD account at the receiving bank using SWIFT MT103 (unsecured) or MT202 (if the receiving account is at the correspondent level). The wire should include the receiving bank's BIC/ABA, the named BC ('MH_BC'), and an unambiguous purpose code in the 70 field, such as 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION - MH_BC - EQUITY INJECTION' or, where the receiving bank accepts it, '/INV/ CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION'. Prior to the wire, the beneficiary bank must hold the account-opening KYC package and a board resolution to verify the source of funds. For funds routed through U.S. correspondents, attach OFAC-compliant wording and ensure the ordering customer is not blocked; no RMI central-bank clearance is required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: SaaS platform disbursements (vendor costs, independent contractor payments, merchant settlement returns, dividends) should clear via SWIFT MT103 (customer transfer) using the RMI bank's U.S. correspondent on Fedwire/CHIPS. For merchant settling through Stripe/Paddle, the payment processors aggregate card/ACH payments and remit to the RMI BC's designated USD payout account through their payout banking partner; this route is treated as an operational settlement and must be disclosed to the main bank as a predetermined payment rail. Commercial letters of credit are not a required rail for SaaS/SEO analytics subscriptions; electronic invoices, subscription billing, and SWIFT transfers provide the appropriate clearing mechanism. Dividend and capital-reduction outflows require board minutes, an updated capitalization table, and (where relevant) a certification of non-resident status for the recipient.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Foreign-exchange forwards (plain vanilla) with a licensed bank or broker, executed offshore and settled in USD
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in USD versus settlement currencies (EUR, GBP, SGD) through a GFX-licensed international counterparty
Cross-currency interest rate swaps or simple FX swaps, subject to the bank counterparty's credit and RMI corporate approval

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Franchise Tax Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before the anniversary of the corporation's date of incorporation; no statutory grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of USD 25 per day up to a maximum of USD 1,000; continued non-filing for more than 12 months triggers administrative dissolution and loss of limited liability protection

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and Corporate Register Audit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent (internal statutory repository; not filed with the Registrar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must respond to the registered agent's annual UBO confirmation reminder within 30 days of the anniversary date; within 30 days of any share transfer or ownership change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to provide accurate confirmation may result in the registered agent resigning, a monetary fine of up to USD 10,000, and potential criminal liability for knowing false statements

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit required only for publicly listed corporations, regulated financial institutions, or corporations exceeding two of three thresholds: total assets USD 10 million, gross revenue USD 20 million, and 100 employees; all other non-resident Business Corporations are audit-exempt
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Financial statements, when prepared, must be prepared in accordance with US GAAP; IFRS is expressly permitted for non-resident corporations

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each year the registered agent sends a confirmation certificate listing all current beneficial owners and shareholding percentages; the corporation must execute and return it within 30 days of the anniversary. Any share transfer or issuance in the prior year must be accompanied by an updated UBO schedule and direct confirmation of the new owner's identity.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - USD 5,000 (when statutory audit becomes mandatory)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Nil effective corporate income tax. A non-resident Business Corporation of the Marshall Islands is exempt from corporate income tax, branch profits tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax, provided it derives no RMI-source income and carries on no trade or business within the Republic. No separate tax holiday is required because the non-resident status operates as a comprehensive statutory tax exemption.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return is required for a non-resident Business Corporation. The only annual corporate compliance filing is the Annual Report under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act, submitted through the RMI Corporate Registry or by the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Report is due before the anniversary date of incorporation, subject to the Registrar’s notice window. Non-resident entities must verify the exact filing date with their RMI registered agent to avoid default.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the Business Corporation and its RMI registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the full name exactly as stated in the Articles of Incorporation; include any company number issued by the Registrar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RMI registered agent: name, physical address, and licensing reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident BC must continuously maintain a licensed RMI registered agent; do not substitute a foreign service address in this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the agent’s registered office address as maintained in the RMI. This is a legal address, not the operational headquarters.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal place of business or management address outside the RMI.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the real economic management address of the SEO content analytics business. Foreign tax authorities may examine this field against substance and place of effective management.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers: full names, nationalities, and residential addresses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List all directors and officers, including nominees. The beneficial owners must be separately identified in records; knowingly false entries are criminal filings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Share capital, classes of shares, and shareholder information.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare all issued shares and provide holder details. Maintain contemporaneous share-transfer records and confirm no prohibited bearer instruments are outstanding.

Confirm that the corporation does not carry on business in the RMI and has no RMI-source income. This declaration is the foundation of the 0% corporate income tax outcome and must be truthfully updated each year.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the Annual Report by the statutory deadline triggers late filing penalties, typically USD 100–200 per month or a higher reinstatement fee; continued non-filing permits the Registrar to administratively dissolve the corporation. Filing materially false statements is a criminal offense under the Business Corporations Act, carrying fines and potential imprisonment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable in practice. The Marshall Islands has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network under which dividend withholding relief would be claimed, and the statutory dividend withholding rate is already nil. If a foreign tax authority requires evidence of RMI tax status, the company must apply through its RMI registered agent to the RMI Revenue and Taxation Division for a certificate of tax residence or official confirmation that the BC is not subject to RMI income tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 0% for cross-border royalties and 0% for interest paid by an RMI non-resident Business Corporation. Treaty rates: not applicable because no comprehensive RMI income tax treaties are in force.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: N/A / USD 0 — the Marshall Islands does not impose corporate income tax and therefore maintains no statutory Local File or Master File threshold. For foreign group compliance, prepare the OECD Local File and Master File when the consolidated group exceeds the participating foreign jurisdiction’s threshold, commonly EUR 50 million or USD 50 million gross revenue.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI Economic Substance Regulations apply to relevant activities, including intellectual property business, distribution and service centers, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, and pure equity holding activities. The target SaaS/SEO analytics business should be analyzed on its actual contracts: if it licenses internally developed analytics IP or holds intangibles generating income, the BC must demonstrate adequate economic substance in the RMI or establish tax residence in a compliant foreign jurisdiction. Adequate substance requires local offices, employees, board meetings, core income-generating activities, and expenditure proportionate to income. Non-compliance may result in financial penalties, information exchange, and strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Certifying AR-7 while the company in fact has RMI personnel, RMI contracts, RMI data-center presence, or RMI-source SaaS revenue; or intentionally omitting RMI business activity to preserve the tax-exempt status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of non-resident tax-exempt status; assessment of RMI gross revenue / business license taxes and applicable import or service taxes; monetary penalties for false declaration under the Business Corporations Act; administrative dissolution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or procure false declarations are personally exposed to civil restitution, regulatory fines, travel bans, and imprisonment for fraud or perjury; courts may pierce the corporate veil where the BC is used as a facade for tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing / Artificial Offshore Profit Booking
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Attributing substantial SEO analytics royalty or subscription revenue to the RMI BC while all actual development, sales, marketing, and management functions are performed by related companies in high-tax jurisdictions, without intercompany agreements, pricing analysis, or economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign tax authorities may recharacterize the RMI BC as a conduit, impose transfer-pricing adjustments, apply penalties up to 40% of the understated tax, add interest, and require CbC/beneficial-ownership disclosure under exchange-of-information mechanisms.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly execute artificial intercompany transactions can be held personally liable for penalties; travel bans and extradition may be imposed where transfer pricing fraud is treated as tax evasion; corporate veil piercing is available if the BC lacks independent economic reality.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Sham Substance under ESR
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining nominee directors, a mailbox registered office, no RMI employees, no RMI premises, and no substance while licensing IP or receiving passive income through the BC; or representing the BC as entirely tax-free without disclosing beneficial ownership in foreign filings.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI Economic Substance assessment, fixed and escalating daily penalties, mandatory information exchange, suspension of the entity’s registration, and strike-off; foreign courts may regard the entity as a sham and disregard the separate legal personality.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and ultimate beneficial owners may be ordered to restore diverted assets, disgorged profits, or tax liabilities personally; travel restrictions may be imposed pending investigation; criminal convictions for fraudulent evasion can lead to imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain accurate beneficial ownership records; concealing the natural persons who own or control the BC; facilitating anonymous Stripe/Paddle subscription payouts without customer due diligence or transaction monitoring; failure to file suspicious activity reports involving RMI corporate accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil monetary penalties under RMI AML/CFT legislation, regulatory censure, freezing orders, revocation of the registered agent’s license, and forced strike-off; banking relationships may be terminated and the entity placed on correspondent-bank blacklists.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who exercise control over corporate funds and knowingly breach AML duties are personally liable for civil penalties; criminal prosecution for money laundering carries asset forfeiture and imprisonment, and courts will pierce the veil to reach personal assets.
